prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic two-person daylight selfie with warm influencer styling.
prompt.main_subject: Two approved adult women with long dark brunette hair and full-glam makeup, one in an opaque red sleeveless top and one in an opaque black high-neck top with sunglasses on her head and a small earring.
prompt.composition_elements: Cheek-to-cheek selfie with heads leaning together and friendly smiles, brown geometric metal privacy screen, green foliage above the fence, sharp focus on both faces, no celebrity likeness.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Bright natural warm sunlight with hard shadows and realistic highlights on fabric and skin, polished social-media glamour mood.
prompt.technical_specs: 4K photorealistic smartphone selfie, wide aperture, sharp faces, natural color, realistic skin and textile detail.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Photorealistic 4K smartphone selfie of two approved adult women outdoors in bright warm sunlight. Both have long dark brunette hair and full-glam makeup. The woman on the left wears an opaque red sleeveless top; the woman on the right wears an opaque black high-neck top, black sunglasses resting on her head, and a small earring. They lean cheek-to-cheek with friendly smiles toward the camera. Behind them is a brown metal privacy screen with geometric star-shaped cutouts and green tree foliage above it. Use warm sunlight, hard natural shadows, realistic highlights, sharp focus on faces, and a polished social-media aesthetic without celebrity likeness.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, latex camisole, strapless bustier, deep neckline, kissing pose, sexualized expression, celebrity likeness, logos, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed.
